audit: Existing original practice MCQ17 FEMA versus FERA four-option direct government source check
question: The Foreign Exchange Management Act replaced which earlier law?

options.A: Companies Act 1956 — incorrect; not the foreign exchange statute repealed by FEMA section 49
options.B: Foreign Exchange Regulation Act 1973 — correct; section 49(1) explicitly repeals FERA 1973
options.C: Competition Act 2002 — incorrect; a later competition statute, not the repealed foreign exchange statute
options.D: RBI Act 1934 — incorrect; not the statute repealed by section 49

source_register.pinpoint: Foreign Exchange Management Act 1999 section 49(1), repeal and savings

source_register.institution: Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance
source_register.pinpoint: FEMA replaced FERA 1973 and commenced 1 June 2000

finding: Existing answer B supported; no manuscript change justified. Repeal includes savings and transitional provisions; do not imply prior liabilities universally extinguished.
